title: LongAgent: History-Guided Agentic Search for Longitudinal Outcome Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.15859v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Extracting informative representations from longitudinal data that can predict future outcomes remains a critical challenge in medicine. Medical datasets are inherently heterogeneous, consisting of a large number of variables collected from different sources, sampled with different temporal spacings, and representing different aspects of human health status. This requires identifying those variables with predictive value, processing longitudinal information, and integrating multiple variables for outcome prediction. Here, we propose a novel agent-based approach, LongAgent, that can autonomously search over combinations of variable sets, temporal windows and longitudinal aggregation functions, and identify candidates with promising predictive performance. LongAgent utilises a history memory of previous searches and numerical evidence to guide subsequent exploration. On synthetic data, LongAgent achieves a mean prediction RMSE of 1.7376 an

translated_title: LongAgent：基于历史引导的智能体搜索用于纵向结果预测
translated_abstract: 从纵向数据中提取能够预测未来结果的信息性表示仍然是医学领域的一个关键挑战。医学数据集本质上是异构的，包含从不同来源收集的大量变量，以不同的时间间隔采样，并反映人体健康状况的不同方面。这就要求识别具有预测价值的变量、处理纵向信息，并整合多个变量进行结果预测。在此，我们提出了一种新颖的基于智能体的方法 LongAgent，它能够自主搜索变量集组合、时间窗口和纵向聚合函数，并识别出具有良好预测性能的候选方案。LongAgent 利用先前搜索的历史记忆和数值证据来指导后续探索。在合成数据上，LongAgent 实现了平均预测 RMSE 为 1.7376 的性能。
tldr: 提出 LongAgent，一种利用历史搜索记忆和数值证据引导的智能体方法，可自主搜索变量集、时间窗口与纵向聚合函数的最优组合，从异构医学纵向数据中识别具有良好预测性能的候选方案。
en_tdlr: LongAgent is a history-guided agent-based approach that autonomously searches over combinations of variable sets, temporal windows, and longitudinal aggregation functions to identify promising candidates for outcome prediction from heterogeneous medical longitudinal data.
